newsitem.title: USA: Saginaw Healthcare, Mich., to merge with St Luke's.
newsitem.headline: Saginaw Healthcare, Mich., to merge with St Luke's.

text.p: Saginaw General Healthcare Corp. and St. Luke's Healthcare Association said they have entered into discussions with the intent of a full merger between the two Michigan healthcare providers.
"The board believes that the combination of these two organizations will optimize the opportunity to develop a Saginaw-based regional healthcare delivery network," a statement from Saginaw said.
The statement said the decision was prompted by "industrywide changes in delivery and payment of healthcare, the need to avoid duplication, and the need to secure health care contracts."

Saginaw said it had adopted a resolution authorizing its chairman, Lawrence Sims, to execute a letter of agreement signifying the intentions of both parties to negotiate the merger. It said it expects the merger agreement to be completed on or about July 31.
